deliverable: reports/fluid-insulin.md
key_findings: DKA resolution indeterminate: Day2 pH7.329/HCO3 21.6 meet acid-base arm but last BOHB 4.2 is Day1; glucose 211-234 not <200. Repeat BOHB with same-tube chem Na/Cl/HCO3/K/Cr before transition.
key_findings: Glucose <250: add 5-10% dextrose, insulin 0.05 U/kg/h, continue until ketonemia corrected (2024 Sec4 Insulin); ADA2026 nurse-driven >=1 U/h. Weight unknown: no fixed rate; 2-3 U/h <-> 40-60 kg arithmetic is illustrative only; current dose adequacy depends on K/ketone/glucose response; weight and MAR missing, so no adequacy judgement.
key_findings: Fluids: saline or balanced both acceptable (2024); balanced better on biochemical outcomes, newer MAs show no significant time-to-resolution difference, no hard-endpoint proof. Current data do not establish an indication for 0.45% saline, pending same-time validated direct-ISE Na/tonicity and fluid balance (measured osm 318 / osmolal gap unresolved); not meeting HHS criteria does not by itself prove all hypotonic-fluid indications absent. Actual fluids unknown (no MAR/I-O).
key_findings: Overlap: 2024 1-2 h vs ADA2026 2 h (general) and 2-4 h (DKA section; refs 63 review, 179 pediatric) - internal inconsistency.
key_findings: Toujeo U300: US PI onset over 6 h, steady state >=5 d, consider longer onset before stopping IV; EU SmPC steady state 3-4 d, not insulin of choice for DKA; 2024 states no studies on U300 transition -> usual overlap not applicable.
key_findings: NovoRapid IV permitted per EU SmPC 4.2 under conditions (vial, 0.05-1.0 U/mL, specified diluents, polypropylene bags, HCP supervision); not regular insulin.
key_findings: K 3.2/3.4: serious limitation, prioritized monitored repletion; pausing running infusion = clinical judgement (consensus with electrolyte-specialist).
key_findings: KPD: Abeta workup (autoantibodies, C-peptide after recovery) - no diagnosis; TG1950: pancreatitis risk, current lipase/amylase without pain do not support AP but cannot exclude.
limitations: No weight/vitals/I-O/UO/MAR/latest Cr/BOHB; no individualized orders
limitations: Did not touch other reports, evidence/, workflow, git, raw original, credentials
